Messages.Author: Orestes
Messages.Body:
Just a quick question about Helena's special ability:

"If Helena is tapped and ready, she can burn a blood to be able to
attempt to block and/or play reaction cards that require Auspex as if
untapped for the remainder of the action."

If she is tapped, can she burn a blood to play Fast Reaction:

"Only usable after a combat between a blocking minion you control
other than this vampire and the acting minion. Tap this vampire. This
vampire now enters combat with the acting minion. The first round of
this new combat, the acting minion cannot strike."

Basically, I'm not sure if the text on Helena, "for the remainder of
the action" allows you to play Fast Reaction.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <c25ded38.03012...@posting.google.com>, Orestes


Reaction cards can only be played when there is an action to react to.

"Reaction cards: A ready untapped minion can play a reaction card in
response to an action taken..." [1.6.3.5]

Since Fast Reaction is playable it is, by that point, necessarily during
an action. Since no new action has started, it is clearly still the
previous (blocked) action when Fast Reaction is played.

If you're worried about when reaction cards can be played, check the
text for Rewind Time. It *specifically* gives itself an exception for
when there isn't an action. Everything else has to go during an action
- and even just before the very end of it, after combat, is still
allowable. See also Cats' Guidance, which goes in a similar slot - just
after combat, but still during the action.
